body: The fuel can is tagged for basement storage and the notebook records a test visit on the same date, with sprayed leaf samples listed. The return box for the container is empty.
title: Basement supply record

body:
Maintenance note: use the hammer mark to find the basement vent. Yellow dust appeared inside after the seed-treatment truck idled above it.

No one wanted to keep the wet copy. It dried unevenly, and the ink from the first entry stayed visible beneath the second.

I wrote the time before I went back for the others. The clock may have been slow; the second vehicle was already gone.
title: Hammer beside the basement vent

body:
Cash receipt at the fuel mark: the crop-study truck took two cans but returned one. The driver wrote that the missing can stayed with the basement samples.

The samples were leaf and soil from the sprayed plots, kept cold. The can was meant to run the pump that kept them so.

I saved the receipt because the driver's name is on the reverse.
title: Fuel mark on the crop account

body:
Fuel receipt headed "Thunder Gas": two cans billed to the crop trial. One can returned with a sharp herbal smell and no cap.

The smell was the same as the spray. The man who filled it said it had been standing in the trial shed.

The well beside the shed has tasted sweet since. I have stopped using it.
title: Thunder Gas charged the field account

body:
Photograph back at the hammer mark: the basement vent was nailed shut after yellow dust appeared inside. The treatment truck had idled directly above it, spraying the yard beyond.

The dust settled on the sample shelves and on the jars. It stained the fingers when touched.

I took the picture before the boards went up.
title: Hammer mark over a sealed vent

body:
Diary line under "basement": leaf jars from three farms occupied the lower shelf. By morning every label had been peeled away, but the dates remained on the lids.

The leaves in each were spotted the same way, black along the veins. Three farms, one treatment.

I copied the dates before the jars were moved.
title: Basement shelf of leaf samples
